author_role: Senior ML Research Engineer & Statistical Reviewer

dataset.name: Student_Depression_Dataset.csv
features: Have you ever had suicidal thoughts ?
dataset.target_disclaimer: Survey-derived self-reported binary label. NOT clinical diagnosis or validated depression outcome.

guarantees: Zero group overlap between outer training and validation sets
Group 1 duplicate rows (15286 and 22442) isolated exclusively inside Fold 2

architecture_a.name: Architecture A: Inner Ensemble Averaging (Primary Research Benchmark)
architecture_a.description: Within each outer fold, 5 inner base models are trained on 80% splits (N~15,178); each corresponding calibrator fits strictly on that model's inner held-out fold (N~3,795). Test predictions on outer validation (N~4,743) are averaged across the 5 calibrated sub-models.
evaluated_hypotheses: Hypothesis 1: Averaging 5 isotonic mappings may reduce probability quantization, to be empirically evaluated by measuring tie rate, unique calibrated scores, and delta ROC-AUC.
Hypothesis 2: Zero distributional mismatch between calibration training and test inference.
tradeoffs: 5x higher test-time inference latency and memory footprint
Requires storing 5 base models and 5 calibrators per fold

architecture_b.name: Architecture B: Pooled Inner-OOF Single Calibrator + Full Outer Model (Secondary Research Comparator)
architecture_b.description: 5 inner base models generate 18,973 out-of-fold predictions across outer train. A single calibrator fits on all 18,973 pooled inner OOF predictions and labels. A single full base model is trained on all 18,973 outer training samples. Outer validation (N~4,743) is scored by the single full base model passed through the single calibrator.
architecture_b.potential_distributional_shift: Inner OOF predictions are generated by models trained on N=15,178, but evaluated at test time on a model trained on N=18,973. Potential score-distribution shift in sharpness or leaf frequencies must be documented and measured.
tradeoffs: Evaluated as a single un-smoothed step function under isotonic calibration
Lower inference latency (1 forward pass) and compact storage

calibration_architectures.architectural_policy: Neither Architecture A nor Architecture B is designated as production-ready. Both are experimental research structures.
calibration_architectures.leakage_proof: Strict partition disjointness guarantees out-of-sample calibration evaluation: the outer validation fold is strictly held out and disjoint from both base model training and calibrator fitting, preventing resubstitution bias, target leakage, and overoptimistic probability assessments.

calibration_methods.description: Direct outputs from predict_proba[:, 1] without scaling.

calibration_methods.sample_size_policy: No universal N >= 1000 guarantee. Sizing adequacy and stability must be established via empirical diagnostics.
calibration_methods.overfitting_risk: Variable based on empirical score distribution; requires clipping at [1e-15, 1 - 1e-15] to prevent infinite log-loss.

threshold_policy.rationale: Threshold tuning using outer validation labels is strictly forbidden to prevent post-hoc overfitting. Probability calibration evaluates posterior fidelity independently of classification decision boundaries.

confusion_matrix_reporting.pooled_oof_matrix: Integer count matrix [[TN, FP], [FN, TP]] on full Development partition (N=23,716)
confusion_matrix_reporting.individual_fold_matrices: Exact integer count matrices [[TN, FP], [FN, TP]] reported for each of the 5 outer folds (Folds 0-4)
confusion_matrix_reporting.substitution_policy: STRICTLY_PROHIBITED: Fractional or mean +/- std confusion matrices are forbidden; exact integer counts must be recorded for every fold.

uncertainty_and_variability_reporting.fold_level_metrics: Per-fold metrics across all 5 outer folds
uncertainty_and_variability_reporting.fold_summary_dispersion: Mean and unbiased sample standard deviation (ddof=1) reported for all metrics to capture fold-to-fold variability

test_suite_accounting.double_counting_resolution: The previously reported 183 figure double-counted test_engine_independence (5) and test_student_experience (7) as if they were separate from the 153 tests in tests/, whereas tests/ contains 126 unittest TestCase methods plus 27 standalone procedural functions (15 platform + 5 engine + 7 student experience). The actual unique test count is exactly 171.

execution_gate.authorization_required: Separate explicit user prompt required for Stage 3B.4 execution.
